one_liner: Reducto is an AI-powered document processing platform that parses, extracts, classifies, splits, and edits 30+ file types at enterprise scale.

auth.notes: API uses static API keys sent as Bearer tokens. OAuth2 device-code flow used for initial MCP server authentication; API key then stored locally.

evidence.snippet: Create a key right here. Give it a name and copy it. It also shows up in Studio under API Keys
This opens an OAuth device-code flow in your browser. Once approved, your API key is saved to ~/.reducto/config.yaml

access.notes: Standard tier includes $150 in free usage credits with self-serve signup, no approval or sales contact needed. Growth/Enterprise tiers require contact form.

evidence.snippet: You can get API access right away by starting off on our Standard tier, pay-as-you-go plan.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: 1,000 req/s sustained per API key globally; 300 req/s for GET /job/{job_id} polling. SDKs auto-retry 429 responses with exponential backoff.

evidence.snippet: Available in Python, Node.js, Go, and REST, with Studio for visual pipeline building.
Full OpenAPI spec with request/response schemas, error codes, and rate limits.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free credentials ($150), documented REST API with OpenAPI spec, webhooks supported, and official MCP server already published.
